teaser.en: A wild asparagus whose name boasts that its medicine could bring down a kingfish.
teaser.sw: Asparagasi pori ambao jina lake linajigamba kwamba dawa yake inaweza kumwangusha nguru.

summary.en: Mwinika ngulu is one of the Digo wild asparaguses, a spiny, wiry plant of the bush. Its name, 'kingfish mwinika', speaks of a medicine strong enough to fell a big fish.
summary.sw: Mwinika ngulu ni mmoja wa asparagasi pori wa Wadigo, mmea wenye miiba na mashina membamba magumu kama waya, unaoota vichakani. Jina lake, 'mwinika wa nguru', linazungumzia dawa yenye nguvu ya kutosha kumwangusha samaki mkubwa.

about.en:
*Mwinika ngulu* is a wild asparagus. Like its relatives it has thin, wiry stems, and what look like leaves are really tiny flattened or needle-like green shoots. Most of the wild asparaguses of the coast are spiny scramblers or small bushes with small white flowers and little round berries.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mwinika ngulu* ni asparagasi pori. Kama mimea ya jamii yake, una mashina membamba magumu kama waya, na kinachoonekana kama majani kwa kweli ni vichipukizi vidogo sana vya kijani, bapa au kama sindano. Asparagasi pori wengi wa pwani ni mimea yenye miiba inayotambaa au vichaka vidogo vyenye maua madogo meupe na matunda madogo ya mviringo.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.

where.en: Wild asparaguses grow in coastal bush, thicket and forest edges, scrambling over other shrubs. Pakia recorded *mwinika ngulu* among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Asparagasi pori huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, wakitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine. Pakia aliripoti *mwinika ngulu* miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Pakia notes that this asparagus is regarded as a strong medicine, with great curative power. The particular illnesses it treats are not recorded.
uses.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba asparagasi huyu huchukuliwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu, yenye uwezo mkubwa wa kuponya. Magonjwa mahususi unayotumika kutibu hayajaripotiwa.

culture.en: *Mwinika* is the Digo collective name for the asparaguses, and Pakia records that it means 'to crouch down'. It is one of the few true folk genera in Digo, with *mwinika ngulu* and *mwinika ndzovu* as its two kinds. The second word works as a boast: *ngulu*, the kingfish, for this one, and *ndzovu*, the elephant, for the other, each said to be brought down by the plant's medicinal strength.
culture.sw: *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo kwa asparagasi, na Pakia anaripoti kwamba lina maana ya 'kuinama/kuchuchumaa'. Ni mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika Kidigo, zenye aina mbili: *mwinika ngulu* na *mwinika ndzovu*. Neno la pili hufanya kazi ya kujigamba: *ngulu*, yaani nguru, kwa huu, na *ndzovu*, yaani tembo, kwa mwingine, kila mmoja akisemekana kuangushwa na nguvu ya dawa ya mmea huo.

names.en: Pakia records *mwinika ngulu*, 'kingfish *mwinika*', a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. No English name is recorded. Pakia's appendices disagree on which asparagus it is: one list gives an unnamed *Asparagus* species, and another gives *Asparagus falcatus*, the species otherwise called *mwinika ndzovu*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *mwinika ngulu*, '*mwinika* wa nguru', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililoripotiwa. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu ni asparagasi yupi: orodha moja inatoa spishi ya *Asparagus* isiyotajwa jina, na nyingine inatoa *Asparagus falcatus*, spishi ambayo vinginevyo huitwa *mwinika ndzovu*.
